column1: # Accepted differences of peers: go-profinet's interop tests report them as "peer-deviation";
# results.json reports them as "known-difference", never as "pass". A peer-deviation without a line
# here is a fail. A waiver whose scenarios ran and no longer deviate fails the run: remove the line.

column6: scenarios (regular expression on the whole stable ID)

column5: scapy has no MRP dissector: the frames are read, not decoded (tshark decodes them).
scapy has no DCP DHCP block class: the first DHCP block and the blocks after it are left Raw.
Wireshark decodes the data of DHCP options 61 and 255 only; option 12 (host name) is shown as undecoded data.
umrp's MRC test monitor ignores the tests of the manager it gave way to: the MRA keeps taking the manager role back.
profinet-py writes I&M1 with BlockLength 58 and two padding octets; the standard block is 56 octets.
